About Bittensor

Bittensor is a decentralized network for machine learning in which specialized subnets reward participants with TAO for producing useful AI outputs. TAO has a 21 million maximum supply.

Where this TAO price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (TAO-USD), Binance (TAO/USDT) and Kraken (TAO/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 9,925,060 TAO (supply last updated October 30, 2026). Prices on different exchanges can differ slightly; the table above shows each one and the spread between them.
